name: Paraparaumu Beach Golf Club
description: Host of the New Zealand Open twelve times, this Alex Russell-designed links is widely regarded as one of the finest in the Southern Hemisphere. Modelled on the great British links, the course features rolling dunes, firm fairways, and challenging seaside conditions along the Kapiti Coast. It consistently ranks among New Zealand's top courses.

name: Royal Wellington Golf Club
description: Wellington's premier private club, set beside the Hutt River with a championship parkland layout that has hosted numerous national tournaments. The mature, tree-lined course offers a demanding yet fair test of golf in a beautiful setting, with the Rimutaka Range providing a dramatic backdrop.

name: Boulcott Farm Heritage Golf Club
description: A well-regarded parkland course in the Hutt Valley, built on the site of a historic colonial farm. The layout features mature trees, gentle undulations, and the Hutt River as a natural boundary, creating an attractive and challenging round close to Wellington.

name: Manawatu Golf Club
description: Palmerston North's premier club, offering a top-quality parkland layout with well-conditioned fairways and true greens. The Manawatu Golf Club provides one of the best tests of golf in the lower North Island and has a proud history of competitive play.

name: Judgeford Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland course tucked into the tranquil Judgeford valley between Wellington and the Hutt Valley. The rolling terrain, native bush backdrop, and peaceful setting make for an enjoyable escape from the city.

name: Miramar Golf Club
description: Conveniently located near Wellington Airport, this course offers harbour views and a compact layout that suits golfers short on time. The elevated positions on several holes provide panoramic vistas across Evans Bay and the surrounding hills.

name: Hutt Golf Club
description: An established Hutt Valley club with a traditional parkland layout featuring mature trees and well-kept greens. The course offers a reliable, pleasant round in a convenient location for Wellington-area golfers.

name: Hutt Park Golf Club
description: A compact 9-hole course in Moera, Lower Hutt.

name: Mahunga Golf Club
description: An 18-hole course in Masterton on the Wairarapa plains.

name: Mornington Golf Club
description: Established in 1916 on the Berhampore Golf Course in Wellington. Strong inter-club structure with a first-class layout.

name: Castlepoint Golf Club
description: A charming 9-hole coastal course near the popular Castlepoint Beach and lighthouse on the Wairarapa coast. Established in 1969 and maintained by dedicated local volunteers, this good-value country course is especially popular with holidaymakers during summer.

name: Shandon Golf Club
description: Founded in 1927 on Gear Island in Petone, providing an excellent test for all golfers. Has hosted several national tournaments.

name: Ngawi Hitaround Golf Club
description: The southernmost course on the North Island, this quirky 9-hole layout sits right on the beachfront approaching the tiny settlement of Ngawi on the Cape Palliser Road. Square greens mown into seaside grass and holes named after maritime misadventures give this rugged coastal course a character all its own.

name: Ohariu Valley Golf Club
description: A friendly 9-hole course set in a quiet, scenic country valley northwest of Wellington, where the soundtrack is birdsong and the occasional sheep. The peaceful rural setting provides a genuine escape from city life, with virtually no traffic and only one hole running alongside the road.

name: Otaki Golf Club
description: Renowned as the best course on the Kapiti Coast, Otaki sits in a beautiful rural environment just a minute from Otaki township. Less than an hour's drive from both Wellington and Palmerston North, the well-maintained layout offers a quality round in a tranquil country setting.

name: RNZAF Wellington Golf Club
description: A tidy 18-hole course on the grounds of the Royal New Zealand Air Force base in Upper Hutt. Open to the public, this par-71 layout offers good value and a well-maintained parkland setting in the upper Hutt Valley.

name: The Morgans - Pauatahanui Golf Course
description: A relaxed 9-hole golf retreat nestled on Paekakariki Hill Road in Pauatahanui, reached via a tranquil one-kilometre drive through native bush. Restored by the Morgan family in 2019, the course welcomes all players in a stress-free, non-membership environment surrounded by a nature reserve.

name: Wainuiomata Golf Club
description: Relaxed golf in a wonderful natural setting just 25 minutes from Wellington CBD, where tui, lorikeet, and kereru frequent the bush-clad hills of the surrounding countryside. The course offers a peaceful escape with native birdsong providing the soundtrack to your round.

name: Eketahuna Golf Club
description: An 18-hole country course on the edge of Eketahuna, where golfers share the fairways with grazing sheep. Celebrating over a century of golf since 1910, the Makakahi Course offers a unique rural New Zealand experience with a relaxed, turn-up-and-play atmosphere.

name: Karori Golf Club
description: Situated in the scenic South Makara Valley just 13 km from downtown Wellington, this course features 18 diverse holes shaped by natural topography, a meandering stream, and elevated greens rewarded by elevated tees. The layout relies on the land's natural contours rather than man-made mounds and bunkers, creating an authentic and varied golfing experience.

name: Manor Park Golf Sanctuary
description: Established in 1913, Manor Park is an 18-hole championship course and internationally recognised Audubon-certified wildlife sanctuary. Set among beautiful native bush and wetlands with gently rolling fairways bordered by the Hutt River, the course is home to over 20 species of bird. Past members include 2005 US Open champion Michael Campbell and professional Gareth Paddison.

name: Riversdale Beach Golf Club
description: Often described as one of the best little courses in New Zealand, this well-maintained 9-hole course sits on the Wairarapa coastline, about 45 minutes from Masterton. Played twice from different tees to make 18, the layout features views of the sea from both the course and the clubhouse.

name: Te Marua Golf Club
description: An 18-hole A-grade course built on gently undulating ground adjacent to the Hutt River, offering a picturesque round with a rural atmosphere. Located just 10 minutes north of Upper Hutt city centre, the course combines accessibility with a peaceful countryside feel.

name: Titahi Golf Club
description: Home club of 2005 US Open champion Michael Campbell and professional Lynnette Brooky, Titahi has a strong tradition of nurturing champions. The course offers a welcoming atmosphere and solid test of golf on the Porirua coastline north of Wellington.

name: Trentham Camp Golf Club
description: A welcoming 18-hole course based at Trentham Military Camp in Upper Hutt, where the inclusive community atmosphere is the club's hallmark. Members of all ages and abilities play together on club days, making it one of the most social golfing experiences in the Wellington region.

name: Palmerston North Golf Club
description: An affordable public course in Palmerston North, offering accessible golf on a well-maintained parkland layout. The course provides good value for golfers of all levels in the Manawatu region.

name: Masterton Golf Club
description: The main Wairarapa club, featuring a well-kept parkland layout in the heart of Masterton. Mature trees and gently rolling fairways provide a pleasant test of golf, while the club's welcoming atmosphere makes it a fine base for exploring the wider region.

name: Waikanae Golf Club
description: A pleasant parkland course near Waikanae Beach on the Kapiti Coast, offering tree-lined fairways and well-maintained greens. The gentle layout and coastal climate make it an enjoyable round for golfers of all abilities.

name: Kapiti Coast Golf Club
description: An affordable public course on the Kapiti Coast, providing accessible golf in a relaxed setting. The coastal climate ensures year-round playability, making it a popular choice for local and visiting golfers.

name: Feilding Golf Club
description: A welcoming rural club in the garden town of Feilding, known for its well-kept grounds and friendly atmosphere. The parkland layout offers an enjoyable round with views across the rich Manawatu farmland.

name: Levin Golf Club
description: An affordable parkland course in Levin, featuring flat, well-maintained fairways that suit golfers of all levels. The accessible layout and welcoming club provide good-value golf in the Horowhenua district.

name: Carterton Golf Club
description: A championship parkland course in the Wairarapa town of Carterton, with well-maintained fairways and challenging holes at an affordable price. The tree-lined layout provides a solid test of golf surrounded by the rolling farmland of the Wairarapa.

name: Martinborough Golf Club
description: A charming 9-hole course in the heart of the renowned Martinborough wine village, perfect for combining a round with a cellar door visit. The relaxed country atmosphere and compact layout make it an ideal stop on a Wairarapa wine trail.
